description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application, including fixtures for setting up test clients, tests for querying endpoints with and without validation errors, and an OpenAPI schema validation.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture to create a test client for different module configurations based on request parameters.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_no_query(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the /items/ endpoint with no query parameters, expecting a successful response with items.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_q_fixedquery(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the endpoint with a fixed query parameter value, expecting specific items and query in response.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_q_fixedquery_too_short(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests validation error when query parameter 'q' is too short, expecting a 422 response with validation error details.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies the OpenAPI schema returned by the API, ensuring correctness of documentation and parameter definitions.
